newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tomen invests $8.71 mln in Indonesia telecom deal.
newsitem.headline: Tomen invests $8.71 mln in Indonesia telecom deal.

text.p: Tomen Corp said on Tuesday it had acquired a 9.68 percent stake in Indonesian consortium Daya Mitra Malindo for $8.71 million to join a government-led telecommunications project in Indonesia.
The project aims to establish new phone lines as well as improve telecommunication facilities and services in Indonesia through private investment, Tomen said in a statement.
Tomen will work together with Britain's Cable and Wireless Plc and Indonesian telecom-related firms in Kalimantan Island until 2011, the Japanese trading house said.
Tomen also said it had separately received from Daya Mitra a construction order, worth a maximum $238 million, to establish 237,000 phone lines in Kalimantan by March 1999.
